title: PROSOCIALDIALOG: A Prosocial Backbone for Conversational Agents

bias_targets.target: Multiple demographic biases (e.g., Racial, Gender, Sexual Orientation)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating dialogue models' ability to generate prosocial, respectful, and safe responses to conversational prompts containing stereotypes and social biases (sourced from the Social Bias Inference Corpus and others) using human head-to-head evaluations across dimensions like prosociality, respect, and coherency.
Measuring the stance, offensiveness, and toxicity of models' zero-shot responses to real-world toxic phrases from the ToxiChat dataset using automated classifiers and toxic n-gram detection.
